member.name: T:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions
member.summary: The command line options of the HttpBench console tool, they match the settings of the HTTP bench page. Every option is optional: an option that is not given keeps the value of the parameter file (-File), else the default.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.File
member.summary: A parameter file (json with "DataType": "HttpBench"), as exported from the HTTP bench page or written with -Save. It is loaded first, the other options override its values.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.Server
member.summary: The root url of the SysWeaver server to test, ex: https://myserver:1212/ (required, here or in the parameter file).

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.Duration
member.summary: The duration of the test in seconds (default 60).

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.Workers
member.summary: The number of workers (default 16): clients that each send one request at a time, with their own connection and session.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.Apis
member.summary: The end points to call, a ';' (or ',') separated list of: All, Default (the modules that are on by default), None, a module ("Files", "Images", "Application", "Auth", "Types", "Explore", "Errors"), an end point ("Application.GetMenu" or just "GetMenu"). Prefix an item with '!' to remove it, a list that starts with a removal starts from the current selection. Ex: "All;!Errors", "Files;Application.GetMenu", "!Explore". Default: the end points of the parameter file, else Default. See -List.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.Values
member.summary: How the apis that take a value get it: POST (the json body, default) or GET (the query string).

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.ValueCompression
member.summary: The compression of the api values: None (default), br, zstd, gzip, deflate (zstd needs .NET 11 or later, which HttpBench is built for). POST: the Content-Encoding of the body. GET: the "_" + letter + base64url query string payload.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.AcceptEncoding
member.summary: The accepted response compressions (the Accept-Encoding header): All (default, like a browser), None, or one of br, zstd, gzip, deflate.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.AnyCertificate
member.summary: Accept any https certificate: true (default, self signed, LAN and expired certificates of test servers) or false (validate certificates).

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.Timeout
member.summary: The time out of one request in seconds (default 30), a request that takes longer is counted as an error.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.Drain
member.summary: The time in seconds that the requests in flight at the end of the test may take to complete (default 5).

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.WaitForServer
member.summary: Wait at most this many seconds for the server to answer "serverTime" before the test starts (default 30, 0 = don't wait).

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.StartDelay
member.summary: Seconds to wait after the server answered, when it didn't answer at once (it was starting, default 10).

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.WarmUp
member.summary: Warm up before the test: true (default) or false. The warm up calls the same end points (-WarmUpSeconds), then the server idles while "serverTime" is called every second (-WarmUpPause), so it can finish its optimizations (tiered compilation) and caches while it stays active. The warm up is not in the report.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.WarmUpSeconds
member.summary: The duration of the warm up in seconds (default 10).

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.WarmUpPause
member.summary: The pause between the warm up and the test in seconds (default 20), "serverTime" is called every second.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.Json
member.summary: Also write the results (the totals, the parameters and the report name) as json to this file, for scripts.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.Save
member.summary: Also save the parameters (after the overrides) to this parameter file, it can be imported on the HTTP bench page.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.NoRun
member.summary: Don't run a test: only show the parameters (and save them with -Save).

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions.List
member.summary: List the modules and end points (the names to use with -Apis) and exit.

member.name: T:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchProgram
member.summary: HttpBench: performance tests a SysWeaver web server from the command line and writes a markdown report. Syntax: HttpBench [options] [report_name]

member.name: M:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchProgram.GetSettings(SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions)
member.summary: The settings: the defaults, then the parameter file, then the options that were given.

member.name: M:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchProgram.Compression(System.String,System.Boolean)
member.summary: A compression option: "none" / "" = none, "all" / "*" = all (Accept-Encoding only), else an http compression code.

member.name: M:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchProgram.SelectEndPoints(System.String,System.String[])
member.summary: The end points of an -Apis selection (see ).

member.name: M:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchProgram.DefaultReportName(System.Uri)
member.summary: "Report_[server].md": the server address without the scheme, the port separator ':' (and anything else a file name can't hold) as '_'.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchProgram.Stopping
member.summary: Cancelled by the first Ctrl+C.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchProgram.Current
member.summary: The run (warm up or test) that a Ctrl+C stops.

member.name: M:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchProgram.Phases(SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchOptions)
member.summary: The phases before the test: the longest wait for the server, the delay after a server that was starting, the warm up and the pause after it.

member.name: M:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchProgram.ResultJson(SysWeaver.HttpBench.BenchRun,SysWeaver.HttpBench.BenchStatus,System.String,System.String)
member.summary: The results as json: "DataType": "HttpBenchResult", the report (relative to the json file), the parameters and the totals ().

member.name: M:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchProgram.WaitForServer(SysWeaver.HttpBench.BenchServerProbe,System.Int32,System.Int32,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Wait for the server to answer, then the start delay if it didn't answer at once.
member.returns: False if it didn't answer in time

member.name: M:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchProgram.Pause(SysWeaver.HttpBench.BenchServerProbe,System.Int32,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: The pause after the warm up: one serverTime request per second, so the server stays active while it finishes its optimizations.

member.name: M:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchProgram.RunWithProgress(SysWeaver.HttpBench.BenchRun,System.String,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Run a warm up or a test and show its progress.

member.name: T:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchProgram.StatusLine
member.summary: A status line that is redrawn in place; when the output is redirected only the last text is written (by ).

member.name: T:SysWeaver.HttpBench.HttpBenchProgram.ProgressMeter
member.summary: The progress of a warm up or test on one console line (redrawn in place), or a line every 10 % when the output is redirected. Also sets the terminal (task bar / tab) progress indicator when the console supports it.
